<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_state():
    g = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = {(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='N'}
    seen=set(); pieces=[]
    for cell in list(cells):
        if cell in seen: continue
        stack=[cell]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            if (r,c) in seen or (r,c) not in cells: continue
            seen.add((r,c)); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                nb=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if nb in cells and nb not in seen: stack.append(nb)
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        mr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2; mc=(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
        pieces.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),g[mr][mc]))
    pieces.sort(key=lambda p:p[2])
    bar = set(g[r][c] for r in range(21,42) for c in range(33,39))
    return pieces, bar

base_bar = {'p'}
def log(label, res):
    pieces, bar = get_state()
    barflag = 'BAR-CHANGED!' if bar != base_bar else ''
    print(f"{label} step={current_frame.step} no_impact={res.get('no_impact')} done={res.get('done')} lvl={res.get('level_completed')} pieces={[(p[2],p[4]) for p in pieces]} {barflag}")
    return barflag

seq = [
 (['LEFT'],'B29 S1'), (['LEFT'],'B28 S1'), (['LEFT'],'B27 S1'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':13}],'S2 B27'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':28}],'S1 B27 selB'),
 (['LEFT'],'B26 S1'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':13}],'S2 B26'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':27}],'S1 B26 selB'),
 (['RIGHT'],'B27 S1'), (['RIGHT'],'B28 S1'), (['RIGHT'],'B29 S1'), (['RIGHT'],'B30 S1'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':13}],'S2 A-sel'),
 (['UP'],'A out'), (['RIGHT'],'A15'), (['RIGHT'],'A18'), (['RIGHT'],'A21'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':31}],'S1 B-sel A-out'),
 ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':35}],'bar click'),
 (['RIGHT'],'bar RIGHT?'), (['UP'],'bar UP?'), (['DOWN'],'bar DOWN?'), (['LEFT'],'bar LEFT?'),
]
for acts,label in seq:
    res = action(acts, intent='explore')
    r = res if isinstance(res,dict) else {}
    flag = log(label, r)
    if flag or r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'):
        print('STOP at', label, r)
        break
else:
    print('sweep done, bar unchanged')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
